flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi resources/sftp/sftp-common.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties (no State Courts server/cron); ocmsadminapi CasIntegrationController (CAS to OCMS direction, not credited); ocmsadminui Icourtmention.d.ts (type only).
note: Requirement status is not given / blank; traced normally. No code identifies notices with mention outcomes or sends applications to State Courts. sftp-common.properties only has ces, mha, toppan, lta, repccs, icms and vhub folders; no State Courts server/folder. The CAS endpoints (casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info) go from CAS/PLUS into OCMS, not from OCMS to State Courts, so they are not credited.
recommendation: Do not claim. No OCMS to State Courts interface exists in the six repos; confirm where it is built.

steps.step: OCMS identifies notices that have a mention outcome recorded and are not yet sent
steps.detail: No query or cron selects notices with a mention outcome or empty send_to_sc_flag; there is no court cron in cron-schedules-prod.properties:62-351. send_to_sc_flag is only a type in Icourtmention.d.ts:20. No entity, repository, service, controller, cron or related term exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (searched: 'state court', 'mention', 'courtmention', 'court outcome', 'acquit', 'discharge', 'DATA', 'send_to_sc', 'roms').

steps.step: OCMS builds the pre-court mention outcome application (application type and status) for State Courts
steps.detail: case_appl_type and case_appl_status are only TypeScript type fields (Icourtmention.d.ts:23-24). No State Courts payload/file builder exists in the backend. No entity, repository, service, controller, cron or related term exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (searched: 'state court', 'mention', 'courtmention', 'court outcome', 'acquit', 'discharge', 'DATA', 'send_to_sc', 'roms').

steps.step: OCMS sends the application to State Courts through an interface
steps.detail: sftp-common.properties:24-38 only defines ces, mha, toppan, lta, repccs, icms and vhub folders; no State Courts server/folder, and thirdpartyapi has no HTTP client to State Courts. Whether the interface exists in another system: cannot verify from repo. No entity, repository, service, controller, cron or related term exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (searched: 'state court', 'mention', 'courtmention', 'court outcome', 'acquit', 'discharge', 'DATA', 'send_to_sc', 'roms').

steps.step: After sending, OCMS records the send date and marks the notice as sent
steps.detail: send_to_sc_flag/send_to_sc_date are only types in ocmsadminui (Icourtmention.d.ts:20-21); no backend code updates them. No entity, repository, service, controller, cron or related term exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (searched: 'state court', 'mention', 'courtmention', 'court outcome', 'acquit', 'discharge', 'DATA', 'send_to_sc', 'roms').

steps.step: Interface errors (roms_error_code / roms_error_flag) are recorded on the record
steps.detail: roms_error_code and roms_error_flag are only TypeScript types (Icourtmention.d.ts:22-27). No backend code captures or stores State Courts interface errors.
